description: This source file implements functions related to SHA-1 collision detection and management within the Git version control system. It provides wrappers and special handling for collision attack scenarios, integrating with the sha1dc library and Git's internal hashing interfaces.

methods.name: void git_SHA1DCInit(SHA1_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Initializes the SHA1 collision detection context with default settings and disables safe hash saving.

methods.name: void git_SHA1DCFinal(unsigned char hash[20],SHA1_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Finalizes the SHA1 collision detection process, converting the hash to hex format and terminating execution if a collision is suspected.

methods.name: void git_SHA1DCUpdate(SHA1_CTX * ctx,const void * vdata,unsigned long len)
methods.description: Updates the SHA1 collision detection context with new data, handling large input sizes by chunking.

ctags.name: git_SHA1DCUpdate
ctags.pattern: /^void git_SHA1DCUpdate(SHA1_CTX *ctx, const void *vdata, unsigned long len)$/
